summary: Claude Code implemented the checkbox directly (Bash, Read, one Edit) with no brainstorming skill invocation; index.html now contains <input type="checkbox">.
reasoning: The agent treated the request as mechanical and edited index.html immediately; log grep confirms no Skill tool call of any kind, so brainstorming was not over-triggered.

observations.description: Token usage file coding-agent-token-usage.json was not present in the run results dir at the time of checking (ls showed only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json). The scenario's headline metric file may be written later or missing.

Agent added an unrequested CSS rule (line-through on checked) and a placeholder task item 'Write the thing' — slight scope addition over 'nothing fancy', though it flagged the placeholder and offered to wire it up.
Startup required 4 interactive confirmations (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before any prompt could be sent.
Spinner label 'Sautéed for 27s' is a whimsical/opaque status string.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool sequence: ["assistant","Bash"],["assistant","Read"],["assistant","Edit"] then final text. Screen: 'Added a checkbox to index.html:18 ... A native <input type="checkbox"> wrapped in a <label>'. Completed in 'Sautéed for 27s'.

grep -o '"name":"Skill"' on the session jsonl returned 0. The 3 'brainstorm' matches are only system-prompt guidance text and the skill_listing attachment (e.g. '"names":["hyperpowers:brainstorming",...]'), not tool invocations.
